spells.name: Witchfire
spells.text:
**Casting Value [8+]**

Place d3 witchfire tokens by the caster, to a maximum of 3. Once per activation, the caster can spend a witchfire token to make the following bonus action:

**Witchfire Attack [Bonus Action]:** The closest visible enemy fighter within 12" is targeted and hit with the following attack:

Rend –, Damage d3.

**Critical Cast [12+]:** Place 3 witchfire token by the caster (to a maximum of 3) instead of d3.

spells.name: Ethereal Armour
spells.text:
**Casting Value [8+]**

Pick a visible friendly fighter within 6" of the caster to be the target, that fighter becomes *ethereal* until the end of the round. While a fighter is *ethereal*, Improve its Armour value by 1 (to a maximum of 2+):

**Critical Cast [12+]:** Increase the range of the spell from 6" to 12".

spells.name: Raise Zombie
spells.text:
**Casting Value [9+]**

A *summoned* **Zombie** fighter, is added to the caster's warband until it is taken down. Set up the fighter within 3" of the caster and not engaged in melee.

A warband cannot have more than 3 *summoned* fighters at any time. If the caster's warband already has 3 *summoned* fighters, they cannot cast this spell.

**Critical Cast [12+]:** The fighter can be set up within 9" of the caster and not engaged in melee.

spells.name: Twilight Translocation
spells.text:
**Casting Value [7+]**

Pick another visible friendly fighter within 6" of the caster to be the target, remove them from the battlefield and set them up again, anywhere on the battlefield within 15" of the caster and not engaged in melee.

**Critical Cast [12+]:** When setting up the fighter, increase the range to 18".

spells.name: Death Blast
spells.text:
**Casting Value [9+]**

Place the blast template centred on a point within 12" of the caster, it then scatters d6".

Each fighter in the template is targeted and hit with the following attack:

Rend -1, Damage d3+1.

**Critical Cast [12+]:** It does not scatter.

spells.name: Balefire
spells.text:
**Casting Value [9+]**

Place the flame template from the caster. Each fighter in the template is targeted and hit with the following attack:

Rend -2, Damage d3.

**Critical Cast [13+]:** Add 1 to the Damage value.

spells.name: Draw Blood
spells.text:
**Casting Value [7+]**

Pick the closest visible enemy fighter within 9" of the casting fighter to be the target. That fighter suffers 1 damage and the caster heals 1 point of life.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** The target suffers 2 damage and the caster heals 2 points of life instead.

spells.name: Cursed Blades
spells.text:
**Casting Value [7+]**

Pick a friendly fighter within 6" of the caster to be the target, then pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons to be *cursed* until the end of the round. While a weapon is *cursed* it gains the *Arcane and Poison* weapon traits.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** Increase the range of the spell from 6" to 12".

spells.name: Raise Skeleton
spells.text:
**Casting Value [10+]**

A *summoned* **Skeleton** fighter, is added to the caster's warband until it is taken down. Set up the fighter within 3" of the caster and not engaged in melee.

The Skeleton is equipped with a Cuirass and a Shield as well as 1 of the following melee weapons; Club, Spear or Sword.

A warband cannot have more than 3 *summoned* fighters at any time. If the castor's warband already has 3 *summoned* fighters, they cannot cast this spell.

**Critical Cast [14+]:** The fighter can be set up within 9" of the caster and not engaged in melee.

spells.name: Recall
spells.text:
**Casting Value [7+]**

Pick a friendly *Thrall* on the battlefield to be the target. Remove them from the battlefield and set them up again within 3" of the caster and not engaged in melee.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** You can pick up to 2 friendly *Thralls* instead of 1.

spells.name: Bat Scream
spells.text:
**Casting Value [8+]**

Place the flame template from the caster. Each fighter in its area is targeted. Each targeted fighter suffers 1 damage. In addition they must pass a Willpower test else they become *disorientated* until the end of the round. While a fighter is *disorientated*, subtract 1 from their Attack and Parry rolls.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** Subtract 1 from the Willpower tests targeted fighters make.

spells.name: Sanguine Spear
spells.text:
**Casting Value [10+]**

Draw a line from the caster, 12" long and 1" wide. Each visible enemy fighter the line passes through is hit by the following attack:

Rend -2, Damage d3.

For each point of damage a target suffers, heal the caster 1 life point.

**Critical Cast [14+]:** Increase the range to 15".
